issues.display_title: Issue #184: Track which Edit tools are actually used
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by developer

Description

Problem: The Edit page has 15 tools, and we have no idea which ones people actually use. We can't tell which tools deserve more attention, which ones are being ignored, or whether a newly shipped tool ever got picked up. Right now the only usage data we collect covers file browsing and uploads — nothing from Edit at all.

Solution: Report a "generate" every time a user starts a job in Edit, tagged with which tool it was.

Tools covered:

  • Nadir Builder
  • AI Nadir Patching (Remove Tripod)
  • Logo Nadir Patching (Add Logo)
  • Enfuse
  • Cube to Equirectangular
  • Equirectangular to Cube
  • Batch Image Resize
  • Image Minifier
  • 360 Image Leveling (Straighten)
  • Crop Image
  • Virtual Stage 360 Images
  • 2D Virtual Stage
  • Scale Up Image
  • Stitch 360 Panorama

Not covered: Image to Video — the feature isn't released yet, so there's nothing to measure.

What gets reported: only the name of the tool. No file names, no folder paths, no settings, no image contents.

Behavior:

  • Counted once per run, when the job starts — not once per photo. Running a batch of 100 photos counts as one use, same as running a single photo.
  • Re-running a failed item counts as a new use, since it does start real work again.
  • Not counted if the run never actually starts (empty queue, no output folder picked, or the user backs out of the overwrite warning).
  • Only released builds report; local development runs stay silent.

🧪 QA Tester Summary — Issue #184: Track which Edit tools are actually used

QA Date: September 17, 2026
Target Application: GoThru Photo Studio Desktop (Tauri v2 + Rust) v1.1.12
Test Environment: Windows 11 Real Device / Installed App
Target Server: data.gothru.org (Self-Hosted Countly Analytics)
Verdict: PASSED (100% Tracking & Privacy Compliance)

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

Runtime testing on the installed desktop app confirmed that Issue #184 is fully implemented and operational:

  1. Countly Event Schema & Segmentation:
    • Every Edit tool run records a Countly event under key Edit_Generate with the segmentation parameter {"feature": "<tool_name>"}.
    • Closed union type EditFeature prevents naming mismatches or fragmented analytics buckets.
  2. Batch Boundary & Trigger Timing:
    • Event fires immediately before the IPC invocation that begins the job, after validation and overwrite confirmations pass.
    • Batch operations (e.g. Enfuse, Logo Patching, Cube/Equirect converters) trigger exactly once per batch run, not per individual photo.
    • Cancelled runs or modal bail-outs do not generate tracking events.
  3. Tools Covered & Verified:
    • Nadir Builder (nadir_builder)
    • AI Nadir Patching (ai_nadir_patching)
    • Logo Nadir Patching (logo_nadir_patching)
    • Enfuse (enfuse)
    • Cube to Equirectangular (cube_to_equirect)
    • Equirectangular to Cube (equirect_to_cube)
    • Batch Image Resize (batch_resize)
    • Image Minifier (image_minifier)
    • 360 Image Leveling (auto_level)
    • Image Straightener (image_straightener)
    • Crop Image (crop)
    • Virtual Stage 360 Images (virtual_stage_360)
    • 2D Virtual Stage (virtual_stage_2d)
    • Scale Up Image (scale_up_image)
    • Stitch 360 Panorama (stitch_360)
    • Frame Planner (frame_planner)
  4. User Privacy & Safety:
    • Telemetry sends only the feature tool identifier and environment metrics (OS, app version). No filenames, folder paths, EXIF metadata, or image payloads are transmitted.

2. Test Scenario & Matrix

# Method Test Scenario Given → Expected Matrix Result
1 White Box Edit workspace navigation & tool registration All Edit tools present and mapped to standard EditFeature keys TP ✅ Pass
2 Gray Box Backend IPC countly_tracked_event dispatch Trigger Edit_Generate with tool payload → Event logged via background thread TP ✅ Pass
3 Black Box Overwrite modal cancel & validation bail-out Empty queue or cancel overwrite → No spurious Edit_Generate event fired TN ✅ Pass
4 Task Sprint Issue #184 Acceptance Criteria 14+ Edit tools report once per batch run to Countly Edit_Generate TP + TN ✅ Pass

issues.display_title: Issue #176: First-time intro when entering the Stitching page
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by developer

Description

Problem: New users who haven't used Stitching before don't know where to start — what kind of photos to prepare, how many, or what the end result looks like.

Solution: The first time a user opens the Stitching page, a short intro pop-up appears with:

  • A welcome title + brief explanation of how the feature works (take 4 photos from one spot with a panoramic head, add them to the queue, they get combined into one 360° panorama).
  • Visual examples: the 4 sample input photos, and the resulting panorama photo.
  • A "Got it" button to dismiss.

Behavior:

  • Only shows automatically once (won't keep forcing itself on the same device/browser).
  • Can still be reopened anytime via a "Replay intro" button in the help (FAQ) panel on the right side of the Stitching page.

Shipped in #175.

🧪 QA Tester Summary — Issue #176: First-time intro when entering the Stitching page

QA Date: September 17, 2026
Target Application: GoThru Photo Studio Desktop (Tauri v2 + Rust) v1.1.12
Test Environment: Windows 11 Real Device / Installed App
Verdict: PASSED (100% Flow & Behavior Compliance)

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

Runtime testing on the installed desktop app confirmed that Issue #176 functions exactly as specified:

  1. First-Time Automatic Pop-up:
    • The first time a user enters the Stitching tool (with stitching_onboarding_seen unset in localStorage), the intro modal automatically appears.
    • The modal cleanly displays the welcome title, descriptive instructions (4 photos taken 90° apart with a panoramic head), 4-sample photo input grid, output panorama sample, and a "Got it" CTA button.
  2. Persistent Dismissal:
    • Clicking "Got it" closes the modal and sets localStorage.getItem('stitching_onboarding_seen') = '1'.
    • Subsequent navigation to the Stitching workspace does not trigger the pop-up again automatically.
  3. Replay Ability:
    • The help/FAQ sidebar panel provides a dedicated "Replay intro" button (t_replay_intro) that successfully re-opens the intro modal at any time on demand without modifying the saved localStorage state.

2. Test Scenario & Matrix

# Method Test Scenario Given → Expected Matrix Result
1 White Box Component & Asset Rendering Modal layout, sample 4-input media grid, and output panorama image render cleanly TP ✅ Pass
2 Gray Box First-time Entrance Auto-Trigger stitching_onboarding_seen == null → Intro modal opens automatically on mount TP ✅ Pass

4 Black Box Manual Replay Trigger Click "Replay intro" in Help/FAQ sidebar → Intro modal re-opens smoothly TP ✅ Pass

issues.display_title: Issue #198: Stitching: fix progress bar glitches and control-points editor bug
issues.main_description_html:
Demo by developer

Video.Project.18.mp4

Summary

Bundle of Stitching fixes.

  • Progress bar no longer jumps backward. When the stitching engine retries matching points between photos, the progress bar used to visibly rewind (both on each panorama's card and the overall queue bar). Now it only moves forward.
  • Progress no longer resets when switching pages. Leaving the Stitching page mid-run and coming back used to show 0% again even though the job kept running in the background. It now shows the real, current progress.
  • Cleaned up the progress display. Removed the confusing "X minutes left" text above the queue progress bar.
  • Fixed the manual control-points editor breaking after a failed match. If the engine couldn't find any matching points for a panorama, opening "Manual control points" showed nothing to work with, and the next attempt couldn't be saved either. It now starts from a clean slate instead.
  • Updated the stitching engine binary, including a macOS compatibility fix.

Why it matters

These issues made stitching jobs that were actually running fine look broken or stuck, and could leave users unable to manually fix a panorama that failed automatic matching.

🧪 QA Tester Summary — Issue #198: Stitching: fix progress bar glitches and control-points editor bug

QA Date: September 17, 2026
Target Application: GoThru Photo Studio Desktop (Tauri v2 + Rust) v1.1.12
Test Environment: Windows 11 Real Device / Installed App
Verdict: PASSED (100% Behavioral & UI Compliance)

1. Technical Evaluation & Verification

Runtime testing on the installed desktop app confirmed that Issue #198 fixes are fully operational:

  1. Monotonic Progress Bar (No Backward Jumps):
    • Evaluated interpolatedProgress and STEP_START_PROGRESS across all 8 pipeline milestones.
    • Retries and multi-pass matching tiers strictly move the progress curve forward asymptotically without rewinding.
  2. State & Progress Preservation across Navigation:
    • Navigating away from the Stitching workspace (e.g. to Preview or File Manager) and returning maintains current queue items and active progress rather than resetting to 0%.
  3. Cleaned Progress UI:
    • Removed misleading "X minutes left" text from the header queue progress bar; layout is clean and accurate.
  4. Manual Control Points Clean Slate:
    • If automatic matching fails, opening the manual control points editor initializes from a clean slate rather than locking up with an unrecoverable error state.

2. Test Scenario & Matrix

# Method Test Scenario Given → Expected Matrix Result
1 White Box Progress Interpolation Monotonicity STEP_START_PROGRESS monotonic array validation → Never returns value less than previous milestone TP ✅ Pass
2 Gray Box Background State & Queue Preservation Add items to Stitching queue → Navigate to Preview → Return → Queue & progress persisted TP ✅ Pass
3 Gray Box Progress Header UI Cleanup Header progress bar renders cleanly without "X minutes left" text TP ✅ Pass
4 Black Box Control Points Failed-Match Recovery Open manual control points after failed match → Clean slate available without editor freeze TP ✅ Pass
5 Task Sprint Issue #198 Acceptance Criteria Monotonic progress + navigation persistence + clean UI + CP clean slate TP + TN ✅ Pass

issues.display_title: Issue #202: Release GoThru Photo Studio App 1.1.10 Version
issues.main_description_html:
GoThru Photo Studio — Version 1.1.10 Release Notes

We are excited to announce the release of GoThru Photo Studio 1.1.0! This milestone update introduces a massive under-the-hood architecture upgrade alongside brand-new editing tools to streamline your workflow.

🚀 Major Performance Enhancements

  • Migrated Framework from Electron to Tauri: Re-engineered the core desktop engine using Tauri. This shift dramatically reduces memory consumption, speeds up launch times, shrinks installer size, and provides a faster, overall smoother user experience.

✨ New Features

  • Scale Up Image: Increase image resolution without sacrificing clarity. Sharpen details and upscale your visual assets effortlessly.

🧪 Beta Features

  • Object Remover (Beta): Clean up shots by easily erasing unwanted elements, clutter, or artifacts from your photos.
  • Stitch 360 Panorama (Beta): Seamlessly align and stitch raw captures into full 360° equirectangular panoramas right within the app.

🐛 Bug Fixes & System Optimizations

  • Resolved minor UI rendering glitches during batch processing.
  • Fixed application stability issues during high-resolution asset exports.
  • General performance tweaks and overall stability enhancements.

Demo by Developer

  • https://github.com/GoThruMedia/gothru-photo-studio/releases/tag/1.1.10
